# Adaptify

> Adaptify LLC builds AI-powered infrastructure for roofing companies: websites, CRMs and an after-hours AI receptionist. Every build is deployed to the client's own Cloudflare account and fully owned by them, never a rented SaaS tool.

## Services
- AI Powered Websites: fast, SEO- and AI-search-optimized static sites built only for roofing companies, free hosting for life, delivered in the client's own Cloudflare and GitHub accounts. Live in 7 days or it's free.
- AI Powered CRM: a custom-coded CRM built from scratch around how a roofing company already works, deployed to the client's own Cloudflare account, delivered in 10 days. One-time build, $1,500 to $4,000 typical range, no subscription.
- After-Hours AI Receptionist (The After-Hours Booking Line): a custom AI receptionist that answers after-hours calls and books the estimate directly onto the calendar, with escalation routing for urgent jobs. Test it with a free instant callback demo before paying anything. $1,500 one-time setup, plus separate minute packages ($99/mo for 200 min, $199/mo for 500 min, $349/mo for 1,000 min, overage billed per minute).

## Websites offer
- Launch: $1,000 one-time. Custom 5-page site, local SEO and AI-search setup, free hosting for life, SSL and security. Live in 7 days or it's free. Includes free domain setup, a Google Business Profile audit and a launch-week review-request system. Optional: +$90/month for 5 small edits.
- Growth: $1,000 setup plus a required $600/month growth plan. Adds 6 SEO blog posts a month, AI search optimization, Google Business Profile optimization, 8 small edits per month (48-hour turnaround) and a monthly performance report.
- Custom package: for anything outside Launch and Growth (multiple locations, bigger builds, etc). Scoped on request.
- Preview first, pay later: no payment until the homepage preview is approved. Clients keep their site, domain and content.

## Ownership philosophy
Every Adaptify service is built once and deployed into infrastructure the client owns outright (their own Cloudflare account), not a tool they rent from Adaptify. The goal of every service is the same: bring the roofing company more customers and make running it easier.
